column7: Read-path cache uncommitted-serve class: a transaction-scoped LocalStorage shares the parent's cache pointer and reads through the transaction handle, so it resolves UNCOMMITTED generations and rows; caching from there publishes an answer that outlives the transaction, and after a rollback the next committed write reproducing the same generation makes it validate and be served. For RoleSetHasPermission that is an authorization bypass (a rolled-back grant keeps authorizing, made EXACT rather than improbable by the monotonic-integer generation); for GetLatestSecretVersion it serves a version row that never committed, with an id SQLite can reissue after rollback. Closed by LocalStorage.cacheEnabled, set only by NewLocalStorage and never copied, so every derived store is cache-free by construction and fails closed; enforced structurally by TestReadPathCacheGuard_RealRepo, which confines every genCache access including reads to the one file that checks the flag.
